title: Where the river takes flight
description: Rising spray carries the player through tall shafts; control the sideways exit onto dry ledges. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

rooms.name: The first falling river
rooms.lesson: Jump into the spray · steer onto the dry ledge. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The river’s stone arches
rooms.lesson: Cross the dry arch crowns between the falls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The tall waterfall
rooms.lesson: Let the spray do the climbing. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: Behind the falling water
rooms.lesson: Descend through the dry chambers behind the falls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The upper river outlet
rooms.lesson: Exit each column before the next stone wall. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The river turns back
rooms.lesson: Leave these falls to the left before crossing to the next outlet. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The last rising cascade
rooms.lesson: Ride the final cascade towards the spring gate. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
